# jans_asset_by_name (Data Source)

Data source for looking up Jans assets by name (GET /jans-assets/name/{name}).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The asset name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `assets` (List of Object) Assets matching the given name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--assets))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
